Use lint/type/security checks and then run the real project tests. Treat MCP Inspector as an optional protocol diagnostic, not permission to spawn arbitrary server commands.

copier-copy.description: Render a reviewed local template without template tasks.

ruff-check.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

ruff-format-check.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

mypy-check.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

bandit-scan.description: Check Python ASTs for common security mistakes.
bandit-scan.notes: The runtime qualifies JSON errors and scanned source counts: parsing/scanner errors or zero scanned source are incomplete even when Bandit exits 0. Rules cover common patterns only; a clean report is not a full security assessment.

pip-audit-requirements.description: Audit an already pinned requirements file without executing pip.
pip-audit-requirements.notes: All dependency names/versions must already be pinned; skips dependency resolution/build execution. Online vulnerability sources may still be incomplete or stale.

detect-secrets-file.description: Check a supplied file for secrets without live verification.
detect-secrets-file.notes: Uses detect-secrets-hook to make discovered secrets fail the gate. No credential validation requests are sent. Project allowlists/baselines are not silently accepted.

jsonschema-validate.description: Validate a supplied data file against an explicit schema.
jsonschema-validate.notes: Schema references may retrieve remote resources. For strictly offline syntax validation use json-check; external schema references should be reviewed before enabling network.

pytest-test.description: Run Python tests with bounded output and JUnit evidence.
pytest-test.notes: Project tests/conftest/plugins execute code and can reach network or mutate their environment. Exit 5 (no tests collected) is incomplete. The runtime also checks the JUnit report so all-skipped suites and missing/invalid evidence cannot pass.

coverage-run.description: Profile branch coverage of a reviewed Python test script.
coverage-run.notes: Uses the isolated coverage environment. Project dependencies must be available there; no implicit dependency installation occurs.

coverage-report.description: Report coverage from an explicitly supplied coverage database.
coverage-report.notes: Coverage failure is exit 2. Missing/corrupt coverage data is an incomplete execution. Threshold is a project policy, not a correctness guarantee. Project coverage configuration may load executable file-reporter/plugins.

tox-test.description: Run one named test environment from the project tox configuration.
tox-test.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

nox-session.description: Run one reviewed Nox session without automatic package installation.
nox-session.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

robot-test.description: Run a reviewed Robot Framework test file or directory.
robot-test.notes: Robot uses exit codes 1..250 for failed tests. 251 is a successful version/help probe only, not a passing test run; 252+ indicate execution problems.

schemathesis-get.description: Generate bounded GET-only checks against a loopback API.
schemathesis-get.notes: GET-only method selection reduces state-change risk but endpoints must honor safe-method semantics. Local schema references and server URLs must be reviewed; scope is the explicit loopback target. Project schemathesis.toml may load Python hooks and write cache/reports. max-examples bounds fuzz/stateful generation; example/coverage phases can add cases, so the runtime timeout remains the overall bound.

playwright-test.description: Run the project browser suite with one worker and JSON output.
playwright-test.notes: The runtime qualifies the JSON report: at least one test must execute, and missing evidence or runtime errors are incomplete. Project configuration and tests execute code; passing tests cover only the declared scenarios, not every browser or interaction.

playwright-screenshot.description: Capture a full-page Chromium screenshot of a loopback app.
playwright-screenshot.notes: Screenshot is evidence, not an automatic visual pass. Page JavaScript may make additional network requests; review the local app and mask authorized dynamic/sensitive content in the project suite.

vitest-test.description: Run the project JavaScript/TypeScript suite once.
vitest-test.notes: Forces passWithNoTests=false even when project configuration enables it. The runtime qualifies executed-test counts and runtime errors in JSON evidence; all-skipped suites cannot pass. Tests and configs execute project code.

spectral-lint.description: Lint a local API specification with an explicit rule set.
spectral-lint.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

redocly-lint.description: Validate and lint a local OpenAPI definition.
redocly-lint.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

oasdiff-breaking.description: Find breaking changes between two supplied API specifications.
oasdiff-breaking.notes: External $ref values may fetch resources. Compare the exact consumer baseline to the candidate; normalization cannot infer intended compatibility policy.

buf-lint.notes: Buf 1.75.0 emits lint and source-syntax diagnostics with exit 100; configuration and plugin execution errors exit 1 and remain incomplete. Local buf.yaml check plugins can execute project-selected programs even for lint; review plugins and policies before allowing project code. Remote module/policy references may use network/cache. Symlink traversal is disabled; no generation or publication command is registered.

grpc-descriptor-list.description: List services from a local protobuf descriptor set.
grpc-descriptor-list.notes: Offline descriptor inspection only; no server address is accepted.

http-head-local.description: Read headers from an explicitly named local HTTP service.
http-head-local.notes: TLS verification is explicitly enabled for HTTPS. The runtime uses an image-owned config disabling HTTPie update checks; project configuration and --verify=no are not accepted. Only the supplied literal loopback target is registered.

graphql-diff.notes: Prefer plain SDL inputs. Custom loaders can execute code or fetch resources; breaking-change policy is the tool default.

curl-head.description: Read HTTPS response headers with redirects disabled.
curl-head.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

locust-load.description: Run a short, small-user load test against a loopback service.
locust-load.notes: Review the Python script: it can override host/methods and execute arbitrary code. Use only a disposable authorized service, not a production traffic source.

k6-load.description: Execute a reviewed small bounded k6 script.
k6-load.notes: Script endpoints, methods and thresholds require explicit prior review; CLI VUs/duration limit offered load but are not a network sandbox. Exit 99 means threshold failure.

autocannon-get.description: Measure a short GET load against a loopback service.
autocannon-get.notes: Latency/throughput capture only; no application-specific SLO is automatically enforced. GET endpoints must be safe and the target isolated.

hyperfine-startup.description: Measure the fixed built-in analysis CLI startup cost.
hyperfine-startup.notes: Only the fixed trusted command is benchmarked. User-provided shell commands or executable strings are never accepted; application benchmarks use reviewed test/profile recipes.

vegeta-report.description: Summarize an existing Vegeta result file as JSON.
vegeta-report.notes: No load is generated. Interpret result validity, target scope and thresholds separately.

pyinstrument-profile.description: Capture a sampling profile of a reviewed Python script.
pyinstrument-profile.notes: Executes the reviewed Python script in the isolated Pyinstrument environment; the project dependencies must be available. Nonzero workload exits, including missing imports, are incomplete rather than performance findings. The HTML profile is diagnostic evidence; no latency or CPU threshold is enforced.

memray-profile.description: Capture allocations while executing a reviewed Python script.

A nonzero workload exit is incomplete even if a capture was written; the capture remains diagnostic evidence, not a successful benchmark or memory-budget finding. To run memray-summary, copy the verified memray.bin artifact to an ordinary workspace file first; internal .specialists report paths are not accepted as operation inputs.

memray-summary.description: Summarize a supplied Memray allocation profile.
memray-summary.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

git-status.description: Inspect local Git working-tree state without optional locks.
git-status.notes: A successful status is inventory only; a clean tree is not a release approval. Does not commit, merge, push, fetch or publish.

syft-sbom.description: Generate CycloneDX JSON for the supplied workspace tree.
syft-sbom.notes: Filesystem package detection is incomplete for dynamic builds and vendored artifacts. An SBOM is inventory, not a vulnerability or provenance pass.

grype-sbom.description: Audit a supplied SBOM with a high-severity failure threshold.
grype-sbom.notes: Network is used for vulnerability database updates. Missing/stale database errors are incomplete; an installed scanner does not imply a fresh advisory database.

trivy-config.notes: Uses embedded checks when the private check cache is empty; check-bundle updates, project trivy.yaml and ignore-file suppression are disabled. Real offline Terraform fixtures confirmed rule coverage. Terraform module references may require network and must be reviewed. The runtime qualifies JSON MisconfSummary coverage; fatal/missing reports and zero checked configurations are incomplete, not pass.

gitleaks-dir.description: Scan local files for secrets with full redaction.
gitleaks-dir.notes: Files larger than 10 MiB are skipped and must be reported as a coverage limitation. Secret values are redacted; paths and descriptions remain private.

actionlint-check.description: Validate supplied GitHub Actions workflow YAML.
actionlint-check.notes: Does not execute workflow jobs. ShellCheck is an optional analysis subprocess from the trusted image.

hadolint-check.notes: The result covers only the supplied inputs and this registered check. Missing dependencies or unsupported inputs are incomplete, not a passing quality claim.

shellcheck-check.description: Lint a supplied shell script without executing it.
